title: Forward Deployed Analyst, Bangalore
jobDescription:
About the team Prompt QL’s Forward Deployed Analysts are data scientists, analysts, or biz ops experts who help shape Prompt QL into a high-quality AI-analyst with enterprise-grade accuracy for our customers. FDAs blend deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills, providing expert guidance and implementation support from initial discovery through post-sale success and expansion. As we scale to meet the needs of our customers and the evolving AI industry, we are placing FDAs into our customer engagements, ensuring seamless adoption, strategic guidance, and world-class service to drive customer innovation and growth, powered by Prompt QL. As FDA, you act as both a strategic partner and hands-on problem solver, helping customers translate business requirements into analytical insights, data workflows, and AI-powered solutions built on Prompt QL. This role bridges deep analytical thinking with fast execution. You will work closely with several technical and/or business stakeholders to understand their processes, diagnose bottlenecks, and design solutions that materially improve decision-making and outcomes for them. Location Remote within Bangalore Role Requirements 5+ years of experience in data science, engineering, or analytics Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into data-driven insights and actionable recommendations Experience working in fast-moving, high-volume operational environments (e.g., logistics, marketplaces, fulfillment, or similarly dynamic domains) Proficiency with SQL, data transformation techniques, and modern analytics tooling Experience building dashboards, analytical models, or decision-support workflows that support daily business operations Comfort working with APIs, data pipelines, and data access technologies Familiarity with AI concepts, large language models, or AI-assisted workflows (not required, but preferred) Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to break down complex workflows into measurable components Experience collaborating with product, engineering, and business partners to deliver cross-functional analytical projects Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences Ability to build strong, trust-based relationships with customer stakeholders and guide them through analytical and AI-enabled transformations Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience About you You thrive in high ambiguous, fast moving start up environments You are able to travel onsite to customer engagements You are highly collaborative and think outside of the box (no egos allowed!) You are curious about emerging, innovative tech, particularly around AI You are a self-starter and customer obsessed Compensation Base Salary: ₹4,489,180
